title: Contract v1 manifest
description: The machine contract of a contract package. A superset of the package-v1 manifest spec 1.0 (schemas/package-v1): it adds `provenance` and `validation` and changes nothing existing, so a contract-v1 manifest is a valid package-v1 manifest -- except one declaring `uncertainty.form: none` (contract 1.1), a value package-v1 does not define. Contract 1.1 also adds the optional `outputs[].field`, `licence` and `provenance.signature`. Structural rules only -- the cross-field invariants (uncertainty.per_output coverage, the entrypoint/executable binding, hash verification, what 1.1 requires of a 1.1 package) are in verify.py, which is the authority.

spec_version.description: Contract spec version as MAJOR.MINOR. A consumer rejects a higher MAJOR loudly and ignores unknown additive keys within a supported MAJOR.

version.description: The model's own semver. Distinct from spec_version.

field.description: What a type: field output holds (contract 1.1). kind, units, support and media_type are what a consumer reads before any run; shape and coordinate_ref describe a field whose node layout is fixed. A package declaring spec_version 1.1 or later gives every type: field output this block with those four keys (open-contract-ml check, rule M019). What belongs to one run -- the node count, the value range, the payload's digest -- travels in that run's answer as an artifact reference, not here.

kind.description: scalar: one value per support point; vector: one vector per support point.

units.description: The field's units, the same as the output's units where both are stated; a dimensionless field says so.

support.description: Where the values live in the payload: on its nodes (points) or on its cells.

media_type.description: The payload format the entrypoint answers with, as a bare type/subtype token, for example application/vnd.vtk.vtp+xml for VTK XML PolyData.

shape.description: The fixed shape of a regular-grid field, in the axis order coordinate_ref states. Absent where the node count depends on a run's input.

coordinate_ref.description: The coordinate convention the shape indexes, in words: axis order, node or cell centring, extent.

form.description: none (contract 1.1) declares a point predictor: the model reports no uncertainty, per_output is the empty mapping and there is no calibration block (verify rule M007). A consumer may refuse such a package by its own policy, and the package-v1 schema does not define the value.

per_output.description: One block per declared output, and none at all under form none. Coverage of every output is enforced by verify rule M007, which JSON Schema cannot express.

executable.description: Must equal the path of the single role:entrypoint provenance artifact (rule M013).

model_card.description: Relative path to the eleven-section model_card.md.

provenance.description: New in contract v1. The card and the validation report are deliberately NOT listed here -- both are written after the artifacts they describe, so hashing them would be circular. They are bound by the model_id / version / dataset_sha256 triple instead.

signature.description: Optional, contract 1.1: {format: oms, path} -- a detached signature over the package, at path, never listed in artifacts. open-contract-ml check warns about a malformed declaration (rule M017) and verifies no signature; this schema states no constraint on it, so a malformed one is that warning and nothing else.

validation.description: New in contract v1. Points at the tiered validation report.

licence.description: Optional, contract 1.1: the licence the model (its code), its weights and its training data are each offered under -- an SPDX license expression with the licence's text or a URL to it, or NOASSERTION with a note. open-contract-ml check holds a declared block to that (rule M020) and warns when a package declaring 1.1 or later declares none (M021). Which licences a package carries is its publisher's policy.

spdx.description: An SPDX license expression, or NOASSERTION.

text.description: The licence text: a file in the package, by its path.

url.description: Where the licence text is published.

note.description: Why no licence is asserted, beside NOASSERTION.
